# `tuple_sketch_summary_integer`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
tuple_sketch_summary_integer(child, mode)
```

Aggregates the summary values from a integer summary type
Datasketches TupleSketch. The mode can be 'sum', 'min', 'max', or 'alwaysone'
(defaults to 'sum').

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not in the function registry yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT tuple_sketch_summary_integer(tuple_sketch_agg_integer(key, summary)) FROM VALUES (1, 1), (1, 2), (2, 3) tab(key, summary);
```

Result:

```text
6
```
